scripts.lint:backend:all: uv run ruff check backend tests
scripts.format:backend: uv run ruff format backend tests
scripts.check: npm run doctor && npm run doctor:test && npm run check:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.docker:up: npm run doctor && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.build.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:agent: npm run doctor:agent && docker compose --profile agent up -d agent
scripts.docker:celery: npm run doctor:celery && docker compose --profile celery --profile postgres up -d
scripts.docker:dify: npm run doctor:dify && docker compose --profile dify up -d dify-graphon-runtime
scripts.docker:kats: npm run doctor:kats && docker compose --profile kats up -d kats-runtime
scripts.docker:image-studio: npm run doctor:image-studio && docker compose --profile image-studio up -d invokeai
